title: Gillig, LLC: High Voltage Batteries May Short Circuit (27 affected)
summary: Gillig, LLC (Gillig) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Low Floor transit buses.  The high voltage batteries may have loose hardware that can fall inside the battery pack and create a short circuit.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Starter-Generator Electrical Connection May Fail (4,557 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2025 330i, 330i xDrive, 530i, 530i xDrive, 4 Series Coupe (430i, 430i xDrive), 4 Series Convertible (430i, 430i xDrive), 4 Series Gran Coupe (430i, 430i xDrive) and X3 30 xDrive vehicles.  The electrical connection between the starter-generator and battery may come loose.

title: Bollinger Motors, Inc.: High Voltage Battery May Short Circuit (17 affected)
summary: Bollinger Motors, Inc. (Bollinger Motors) is recalling certain 2025 B4 trucks.  The high voltage battery pack may be improperly sealed and allow liquid to enter the battery.

title: Jayco, Inc.: Fuel Filter Hoses May Disconnect and Leak Fuel (34 affected)
summary: Jayco, Inc. (Jayco) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Entegra Anthem, Aspire, and 2025 Reatta XL motorhomes, equipped with Cummins L9 diesel engines.  The remote fuel filter hose may separate from the fitting, causing a fuel leak and an engine stall.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): Headlights May Flicker or Shut Off (7,212 affected)
summary: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2018-2025 CB300R motorcycles.  The headlights may flicker or shut off while driving.

title: Autocar, LLC: Insufficient Air Volume in Brake System/FMVSS 121 (5 affected)
summary: Autocar, LLC (Autocar) is recalling certain 2023-2024 DC (Legend) vehicles.  The air tanks have an insufficient volume of air for the brake system.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 121, "Air Brake Systems."

title: Autocar, LLC: Blower Motor may Short Circuit and Cause Fire (1,000 affected)
summary: Autocar, LLC (Autocar) is recalling certain 2020-2026 DC (Legend) vehicles.  The incorrect blower motor fuse may have been installed.

title: Nova Bus (US) Inc.: High Voltage Batteries May Short Circuit (24 affected)
summary: Nova Bus (US) Inc. (Nova Bus) is recalling certain 2022-2023 Nova Bus LFS transit buses.  The high voltage batteries may have loose hardware that can fall inside the battery pack and create a short circuit.

title: Shyft Group: High Voltage Battery May Short Circuit (23 affected)
summary: Shyft Group (Shyft) is recalling certain Blue Arc BA4L-800 vehicles equipped with Aries LFP battery packs.  The battery pack may be improperly sealed and allow liquid to enter the battery.

title: Starcraft RV: Incorrect Safety Chains May Fail (15 affected)
summary: Starcraft RV (Starcraft) is recalling certain 2025 Autumn Ridge travel trailers.  The installed safety chains are rated at 7,600 lbs. and the actual Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) is 7,995 lbs.  This can cause the chains to fail, allowing the tow vehicle to separate from the trailer.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Solar Panel Wiring May Melt Causing Fire (69 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2025 Coachmen Apex and Remote travel trailers.  The solar panel wiring may be incorrectly wired to the battery, causing it to melt.

title: Nova Bus (US) Inc.: Loss of Drive Power (45 affected)
summary: Nova Bus (US) Inc. (Nova Bus) is recalling certain 2022-2023 LFS transit buses.  The engine wiring harness may be the incorrect length, which can result in harness damage and a loss of drive power.

title: Porsche Cars North America, Inc.: Rearview Camera Image May Not Display/FMVSS 111 (8,571 affected)
summary: Porsche Cars North America, Inc. (Porsche) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Macan Electric vehicles.  The rearview camera may show a blurry image or fail to display.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 111, "Rear Visibility."

title: ILJIN Hysolus: CNG Fuel Tank May Rupture/FMVSS 304 (3,584 affected)
summary: ILJIN Hysolus (ILJIN) is recalling certain Compressed Natural Gas (CNG) tanks.  For a complete list of part numbers, please see the attached document.  The pressure relief device may not fully vent, which can cause the tank to rupture.  As such, these tanks fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 304, "Compressed Natural Gas Fuel Container Integrity."

title: Harley-Davidson Motor Company: Reflector May Become Obstructed/FMVSS 108 (222 affected)
summary: Harley-Davidson Motor Company (Harley-Davidson) is recalling certain Fairing Lowers installed on 2023-2025 Touring and CVO Touring, Inverted Forks installed on 2025 FLHXU, and Fairing Lowers and Inverted Forks kits installed on 2024-2025 FLHX and FLTRX motorcycles.  These accessories may obstruct the visibility of the front and side reflectors.  As such, motorcycles equipped with these accessories fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Volvo Trucks North America: Hazard Switch Back Lighting May Fail/FMVSS 101 (5,257 affected)
summary: Volvo Trucks North America (Volvo Trucks) is recalling certain 2023-2026 New VN trucks.  The hazard switch back lighting may become inoperative.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 101, "Controls and Displays."

title: WHITE RIVER MARINE GROUP LLC: Winch Strap May Fail Allowing Boat to Detach (2,164 affected)
summary: White River Marine Group LLC (WRMG) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Tracker Marine Trailstar TRL and Topper boat trailers.  The winch strap may fray after contacting the crossbar and break, allowing the boat to detach from the trailer.

title: Hiab USA Inc.: Lift Gate May Fail (217 affected)
summary: Hiab USA Inc. (Hiab) is recalling certain Waltco ZS-MK2 series lift gates, with model numbers ZS-MK2-STD 2000-155 12V and ZS-MK2-SLI 2000-155 12V.  The cylinder pin in the slide liftgate may be insufficiently lubricated, which can cause the pin to seize, resulting in lift gate failure.

title: Chicco USA, Inc.: Child Seat May Allow Excessive Movement/FMVSS 213 (30,984 affected)
summary: Chicco USA, Inc. (Chicco) is recalling certain MyFit Zip Air Harness and Booster child restraint seats (CRS) with model numbers 07079561970070 and 04079561190070.  In certain configurations, the child seat may allow excessive chest movement in a crash.  As such, these child seats fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 213, "Child Restraint Systems."

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: Rearview Camera Image May Not Display/FMVSS 111 (98 affected)
summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Audi) is recalling certain 2025 SQ6 and Q6 vehicles.  The rearview camera image may be delayed or deactivated after shifting into reverse.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 111, "Rear Visibility."

title: McLaren Automotive Incorporated: Wheel Lock Up from Incorrectly Routed Brake Lines (29 affected)
summary: McLaren Automotive Incorporated (McClaren) is recalling certain 2020-2025 600LT, 720S, Artura, GT, and GTS vehicles.  The brake lines may be routed incorrectly and cause the brakes on the incorrect side to activate, possibly resulting in one of the rear wheels locking up.

title: Alliance RV, LLC: Incorrect Weight Information on Label (152 affected)
summary: Alliance RV, LLC (Alliance) is recalling certain 2025 Avenue 23ML travel trailers.  The Federal Placard may have the incorrect Unloaded Vehicle Weight (UVW) and Cargo Carrying Capacity (CCC) information, allowing the trailer to be overloaded.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: Rearview Camera May Show Blurry Image/FMVSS111 (313 affected)
summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Audi) is recalling certain 2025 SQ6 e-tron and Q6 e-tron vehicles. The rearview camera may show a blurry image.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 111, "Rear Visibility."

title: Corp. Micro Bird, Inc.: U-Bolts Securing Suspension May Break (3 affected)
summary: Corp. Micro Bird, Inc. (Micro Bird) is recalling certain 2023 G5 transit buses.  The u-bolts securing the suspension blades may break.

title: Corp. Micro Bird, Inc.: U-Bolts Securing Suspension May Break (102 affected)
summary: Corp. Micro Bird, Inc. (Micro Bird) is recalling certain 2023 G5 school buses.  The u-bolts securing the suspension blades may break.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): Stabilizer Bar May Detach and Damage Cables (9 affected)
summary: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2024 Acura ZDX vehicles.  The passenger-side front stabilizer bar bracket bolts may have been improperly tightened, which can allow the bolts to loosen and separate from the vehicle frame.  A detached stabilizer bar or bracket can damage the vehicle's high voltage cables or EV battery coolant lines.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: Incorrect Brake System Warning Light/FMVSS 135,101 (5,637 affected)
summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling certain 2025 ID. Buzz vehicles.  The brake system warning light on the instrument panel display may be the incorrect symbol and color.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard numbers 135, "Light Vehicle Brake Systems" and 101, "Control and Displays."

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Incorrect Tire Inflation Pressure Information (10,423 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2025 Ram 1500 vehicles.  A software error may cause an incorrect tire inflation pressure message to display on the instrument panel.

title: Oshkosh Corporation: Improperly Manufactured Front Axle May Fail (469 affected)
summary: Oshkosh Corporation (Oshkosh) is recalling certain 2024-2025 S-Series vehicles.  The front axle housing wall thickness may not be sufficient and can cause the axle to fail.

title: MORryde International, Inc.: Removable Steps May Detach While In Use (15,490 affected)
summary: MORryde International, Inc. (MORryde) is recalling certain Clip-On brackets, with part numbers STP57-515 and STP57-641.  The clip-on bracket mounting bolts for the removable step may come loose, which can cause the steps to detach.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Sewer Gas Inside Cabin (23 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2025 Coachmen Brookstone BKF398MBL fifth wheels.  The wastewater holding tank pipe may not extend to the exterior of the vehicle, allowing sewer gas to enter the cabin.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Sewer Gas Inside Cabin (27 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain Coachmen Catalina BCAT154RBX travel trailers.  The wastewater holding tank pipe may not extend to the exterior of the vehicle, allowing sewer gas to enter the cabin.

title: General Motors, LLC: Stabilizer Bar May Detach and Damage Cables (17 affected)
summary: General Motors LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2023-2025 Cadillac LYRIQ vehicles.  The left or right front stabilizer bar bracket bolts may have been improperly tightened, which can allow the bolts to loosen and separate from the vehicle frame.  A detached stabilizer bar or bracket can damage the vehicle's high voltage cables or EV battery coolant lines.

title: Ford Motor Company: Rearview Camera Image May Not Display (4,625 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2022-2023 Transit vehicles previously repaired incorrectly under recall number 23V-598.  The rearview camera, or 360-degree view camera if equipped, may not display a rearview image when the vehicle is placed in reverse.

title: Jayco, Inc.: Damaged Fuel Filter Housing May Cause Fuel Leak (34 affected)
summary: Jayco, Inc. (Jayco) is recalling certain 2025 Entegra Aspire, 2025-2026 Entegra Anthem, and Cornerstone motorhomes.  The fuel filter housing may become damaged from contact with the rear cap support bracket, causing a fuel leak.

title: Ford Motor Company: Software Error May Cause Loss of Drive Power (24,655 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2025 Explorer vehicles.  The powertrain control module (PCM) may reset while driving, which can damage the park system or cause an engine stall.

title: Ford Motor Company: Power Windows May Pinch/FMVSS 118 (1,177 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2024 Ranger and 2024 Lincoln Nautilus vehicles previously repaired incorrectly under recall number 24V-597.  When closing the windows with the global closing feature, the windows may not automatically reverse after detecting an object.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 118, "Power-Operated Window Systems."

title: Ford Motor Company: Loss of Brake Function from Brake Fluid Leak (123,611 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2017-2018 F-150, Expedition, and Lincoln Navigator vehicles.  The brake master cylinder may allow brake fluid to leak from the front wheel circuit into the brake booster.

title: Ford Motor Company: High Voltage Battery Water Damage May Cause Fire (457 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2024-2025 E-Transit Chassis Cab vehicles.  The tray side rails for the high voltage battery pack may buckle and crack, allowing water to enter the battery.

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: Improperly Secured Electrical Wiring Harness (14 affected)
summary: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2024 E 350 4MATIC, E 450 4MATIC All-Terrain, and E 450 4MATIC vehicles.  The 12-Volt and 48-Volt ground connections for the electrical wiring harness may not be secured properly, resulting in the ground connections overheating.

title: Hyundai Motor America: Reduced Braking Performance from Software Error (1,589 affected)
summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2025 Hyundai IONIQ 5 "N" vehicles equipped with left-foot braking (LFB) and N e-shift features.  The integrated electronic brake (IEB) and vehicle control unit (VCU) software may cause reduced braking performance when LFB is activated.  Additionally, the vehicle may continue to accelerate after the pedal is released and the vehicle's N e-shift feature is engaged.

title: Oshkosh Corporation: Rearview Camera Image May Not Display/FMVSS 111 (216 affected)
summary: Oshkosh Corporation (Oshkosh) is recalling certain 2025 Defense NGDV ICE 2WD, AWD, and BEV 2WD vehicles.  The rearview camera image may not display when the vehicle is placed in reverse.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 111, "Rear Visibility."

title: Nova Bus (US) Inc.: Air Leak in Brake Chamber (2,090 affected)
summary: Nova Bus (US) Inc. (Nova Bus) is recalling certain ZF North America Knorr-Bresme 20/22-57 brake chambers, with part number K038830N00, sold as replacement parts for certain buses.  The brake chamber may have been improperly manufactured, which can result in an air leak.

title: Prevost Car (US) Inc.: Emergency Exit Windows Difficult to Open/FVMSS 217 (15 affected)
summary: Prevost Car (US) Inc. (Prevost) is recalling certain 2025 Prevost H3-45 and X3-45 motorcoaches.  The release mechanism on the emergency exit windows may be difficult to open in an emergency situation.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 217, "Bus Emergency Exits and Window Retention and Release."

title: Maserati North America, Inc.: Tire Information Label May Detach/FMVSS 110 (21 affected)
summary: Maserati North America, Inc. (Maserati) is recalling certain 2024 Granturismo vehicles.  The tire label may detach from the driver's side B-Pillar.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 110, "Tire Selection and Rims."

title: Forest River, Inc.: Removable Steps May Detach While In Use (4,179 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Coachmen Catalina, Forest River Aurora, Cascade, Cedar Creek, Cherokee, Sandpiper, Sierra, 2025 Campsite Reserve, Impression, Pause, Puma, Sabre, Salem, Vengeance, and Wildwood fifth wheel and travel trailers, equipped with a removable step assembly.  The clip-on bracket mounting bolts may come loose, allowing the steps to detach.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: Front Passenger Air Bag May Not Deploy (3,773 affected)
summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Audi) is recalling certain 2022-2023 RS E-TRON GT and E-TRON GT vehicles.  The passenger occupant detection system (PODS) may experience a fault in the wiring and deactivate the front passenger air bag when the seat is occupied.

title: Goodyear Tire & Rubber Company: Incorrect Tire Identification Number/FMVSS 574 (96 affected)
summary: Goodyear Tire & Rubber Company (Goodyear) is recalling certain Cooper Discoverer Stronghold AT tires, size LT275/65R18.  The tire identification number (TIN) is missing the 4-digit week and year code mark.  As such, these tires fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard Number 574, "Tire Identification & Recordkeeping."

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Rearview Camera Image May Not Display/FMVSS 111 (48,527 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2023-2025 Alfa Romeo Tonale and Dodge Hornet vehicles.  The display module may not show the rearview camera image.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 111, "Rear Visibility."

title: Pure Sports Distributing Inc.: Unstable Idling or Engine Stall from TPS Failure (216 affected)
summary: Pure Sports Distributing Inc. (Yamaha of Hawaii) is recalling certain 2022 MT-09 Tracer GT, 2021-2025 MT-09 SP, 2021-2025 MT-09, 2022-2023 and 2025 MT-10 SP, 2022-2024 MT-10 and 2022-2024 XSR900 motorcycles.  The brushes inside the Throttle Position Sensor (TPS) may slide excessively due to improper ECU programming, possibly causing unstable idling or an engine stall.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Damaged Front Brake Discs (26 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2025 X3 30 xDrive vehicles.  The front brake discs may have been damaged during transport before they were installed on the vehicle.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): Vehicle Lighting Failure (152,800 affected)
summary: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2014-2020 Acura MDX vehicles.  Moisture may enter the tailgate lid light assembly and wiring harness, which can cause the interior and exterior lights to fail, including the lid lights, position lights, license plate lights and taillights.

title: Autocar, LLC: Misrouted Alternator Ground Cable May Start Fire (224 affected)
summary: Autocar, LLC (Autocar) is recalling certain 2023-2024 ACTT (Xspotter) vehicles.  The alternator ground cable may be misrouted and contact the alternator positive stud, damaging the cable.

title: Volvo Trucks North America: Idler Gear May Detach Causing Engine Stall (102 affected)
summary: Volvo Trucks North America (Volvo Trucks) is recalling certain 2022-2025 Volvo VN and 2025 New VN trucks.  The idler gear bracket fasteners may have been improperly tightened, allowing the idler gear to detach from the engine.

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: Incorrect Stability System Warning Light/FMVSS 126 (6,247 affected)
summary: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2025 G 550, G 580, and AMG G 63 vehicles.  The vehicle's electronic stability program (ESP) may display an incorrect warning light during an ESP system failure.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 126, "Electronic Stability Control Systems," and 101, "Control and Displays."

title: Altec Industries, Inc.: Unseated Retaining Ring May Cause Cylinder Failure (900 affected)
summary: Altec Industries, Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Digger Derrick vehicles.  An improperly seated retaining ring may cause the hydraulic cylinder to lose pressure, resulting in unintended boom movement.

title: Altec Industries, Inc.: Pedestal and Truck Frame May Separate (103 affected)
summary: Altec Industries, Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2014-2016 AT200A aerial devices.  Cracks may develop in the legs of the mounting frame, which can cause the mounting frame side plate to break.

title: Temsa: Incorrect Weight Rating on Label/FMVSS 120 (11 affected)
summary: Temsa is recalling certain 2024-2025 TS45 transit buses.  The Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) listed on the certification label is incorrect.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 120, "Wheels and Rims - Other Than Passenger Cars."

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: Idler Gear May Detach Causing Engine Stall (3 affected)
summary: Mack Trucks, Inc. (Mack) is recalling certain 2025 Anthem (AN) vehicles.  The idler gear bracket fasteners may have been improperly tightened, allowing the idler gear to detach from the engine.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Slide-room Floor May Not Properly Retain Seat Belt (16 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2025 East to West Bravado BRC33DSF motorhomes.  The slide-room floor may detach from the vehicle in the open position.  Additionally, the slide-room floor may not properly retain the seat belts during a crash.

title: Motiv Power Systems: Electrical Short Can Cause Loss of Drive Power (139 affected)
summary: Motiv Power Systems, Inc. (Motiv) is recalling certain 2019-2022 F-53 and F-59 vehicles equipped with a Motiv Gen 5 EPIC powertrain.  A support bracket may fatigue and break, allowing the main power disconnect to contact other structures and short.

title: Ford Motor Company: Loss of Steering from Front Control Arm Separation (2 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2025 Bronco vehicles.  The front upper control arm ball joint nut may be missing or tightened improperly, allowing the front upper control arm to detach from the knuckle assembly.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Wiring Missing Circuit Protection (975 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Forest River Aurora and Coachmen Catalina travel trailers.  Please see the 573 report for the complete list of model numbers.  The front exterior accent lights, awning, and auto-leveling system may be incorrectly wired and not have proper over current circuit protection.

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: Incorrect Weight Rating on GAWR and GVWR Label (37,003 affected)
summary: Nissan North America, Inc. (Nissan) is recalling certain 2025 Kicks vehicles.  The certification label may have been printed with the incorrect Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) and Gross Axle Weight Rating (GAWR) values, which can result in the vehicle being overloaded.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of 49 CFR Part 567, "Certification."  Additionally, certain 2025 Nissan Kicks SR trim level vehicles equipped with an optional 19-inch wheel package may have a certification label that states an incorrect wheel size.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 110, "Tire Selection and Rims."

title: Highland Ridge RV: Incorrect GAWR and Tire Information/FMVSS 110 (24 affected)
summary: Highland Ridge RV (Highland Ridge) is recalling certain 2025 Highland Ridge GO Play travel trailers.  The certification and tire information labels may have the incorrect Gross Axle Weight Rating (GAWR) and state the incorrect tire and rim size.  As such, these vehicles fail to conform to Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 110, "Tire Selection and Rims" and the requirements of 49 CFR Part 567, "Certification."

title: Blue Bird Body Company: Failure to Detect a Loss of Brake Assist (162 affected)
summary: Blue Bird Bus Company (Blue Bird) is recalling certain 2022-2024 Vision electric school buses equipped with hydraulic brakes.  The system software may fail to detect and alert the driver to a loss of the secondary brake assist.

title: Motiv Power Systems: Electrical Short Can Cause Loss of Drive Power (3 affected)
summary: Motiv Power Systems, Inc. (Motiv) is recalling certain 2020 F-59 school buses equipped with a Motiv Gen 5 EPIC powertrain.  A support bracket may fatigue and break, allowing the main power disconnect to contact other structures and short.

title: Dorel Juvenile Group: Choking Hazard from Foam in Child Seat Headrest (179,845 affected)
summary: Dorel Juvenile Group (Dorel) is recalling certain Safety 1st Grow & Go Sprint child seats.  The included model numbers are CC321GYU, CC321GYUD, CC321GYY, CC321GYYD, CC321HAO, and CC321HAR.  The headrest foam pad is not adequately secured, which can allow a child to pick off pieces of foam.

title: Shyft Group: Improperly Tightened Seat Fasteners/FMVSS 207 (163 affected)
summary: Shyft Group (Shyft) is recalling certain 2022-2025 Utilimaster Aeromaster Upfit vehicles.  The suspension seat mounting fasteners may have been improperly tightened.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 207, "Seating Systems."

title: Alliance RV, LLC: Removable Steps May Detach While In Use (32 affected)
summary: Alliance RV, LLC (Alliance) is recalling certain 2025 Benchmark 42LFT travel trailers, equipped with a removable step assembly.  The clip-on bracket mounting bolts may come loose, allowing the steps to detach.

title: International Motors, LLC: Driver's Seat Belt May Fail (964 affected)
summary: International Motors, LLC (International) is recalling certain 2025-2026 IC CESB and 2025 EVSB school buses.  The driver's seat belt anchor bolt may come loose.

title: Ford Motor Company: Improperly Secured Battery May Cause Fire (3 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2023 F-150 Lightning vehicles.  The fasteners that secure the junction box bus bars inside the high-voltage battery pack may not have been tightened securely, which can cause electrical arcing at the busbars.

title: Ford Motor Company: Blank or Distorted Rearview Camera Image (160,729 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2015 F-250, F-350, F-450, Expedition, Lincoln Navigator, and MKC vehicles.  The rearview camera printed circuit board terminal header connector may be loose or damaged, which can result in a blank or distorted image.

title: Ford Motor Company: Missing Dashboard Air Bag Warning Label/FMVSS 208 (326 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2025 F-150 vehicles.  The air bag warning label may be missing from the dashboard.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."

title: International Motors, LLC: Windshield Wipers May Fail (14,786 affected)
summary: International Motors, LLC (International) is recalling certain 2025-2026 HV, HX, LT, MV, RH, and 2025 EMV vehicles.  The linkage that connects the right-side wiper arm to the motor may separate, causing the wipers to fail.

title: Bombardier Recreational Products, Inc.: Water May Enter High Voltage Battery (478 affected)
summary: Bombardier Recreational Products (BRP) is recalling certain 2025 Can-Am Origin and Pulse electric motorcycles.  The breather valve may not seal properly and allow moisture or water to enter the high voltage battery.

title: General Motors, LLC: Engine Failure (597,571 affected)
summary: General Motors LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2021-2024 Cadillac Escalade and Escalade ESV, Chevrolet Silverado 1500, Suburban, and Tahoe, GMC Sierra 1500, Yukon, and Yukon XL vehicles equipped with a 6.2L V8 gas engine.  The connecting rod and/or crankshaft engine components may have manufacturing defects that can lead to engine damage and engine failure.

title: Carrier Corporation: APU Terminal Block May Short and Cause Fire (4,661 affected)
summary: Carrier Corporation (Carrier) is recalling certain Aspen Auxiliary Power Unit (APU) models Aspen-INT, Aspen-STA, and Aspen-PWR.  The APU positive terminal block may have corrosion, resulting in a short circuit.

title: Polestar Automotive USA, Inc.: Rearview Camera Image May Not Display/FMVSS 111 (27,816 affected)
summary: Polestar Automotive USA, Inc. (Polestar) is recalling certain 2021-2025 Polestar 2 vehicles.  The rearview camera image may not display when the vehicle is placed in reverse.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 111, "Rear Visibility."

title: Forest River Bus, LLC: Incorrect Entry Door Wiring May Cause Fire (453 affected)
summary: Forest River Bus, LLC (Forest River Bus) is recalling certain 2023-2025 Champion Challenger, Defender, 2024-2025 Glaval Entourage, and 2023-2024 Glaval Universal transit buses.  The entry door ground wire may be incorrectly connected to the positive side of the battery instead of the negative ground.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Wiring Missing Circuit Protection (59 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2025 Stealth and XLR fifth wheel travel trailers.  The front exterior accent lamp wire may not have proper over current circuit protection.

title: Zoox, Inc.: ADS Software Error May Cause Crash (270 affected)
summary: Zoox, Inc. (Zoox) is recalling certain Automated Driving Systems (ADS) equipped with software versions released prior to April 17, 2025.  In certain driving scenarios, the Zoox vehicle may make an inaccurate prediction when another vehicle slowly approaches perpendicularly and stops.  In these scenarios, the Zoox vehicle may not be able to avoid a crash.

title: Key Safety Systems, Inc. - (DBA Joyson): Side Curtain Air Bag Inflators May Rupture (16,244 affected)
summary: Key Safety Systems, Inc. - (DBA Joyson) submitted a defect information report based upon the recall determinations made by General Motors, LLC (24V-756, 25V-432) and Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) (25V-010).  The right and left side curtain air bag inflators may rupture due to a manufacturing defect.

title: Isuzu Motors Limited: Loss of Drive Power from Cooling Pump Failure (73 affected)
summary: Isuzu Motors Limited (Isuzu) is recalling certain 2025 NRR EV trucks. Due to a mix of incompatible coolants, debris may build up in the cooling system, causing the cooling pump to fail.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Loss of Drive Power from Damaged PTU (63,130 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2017-2019 Jeep Cherokee vehicles.  The power transfer unit (PTU) may become damaged and disengage the transmission and differential, resulting in a loss of drive power and/or loss of park function.

title: Temsa: Brakes May Engage Unexpectedly and Overheat (594 affected)
summary: Temsa is recalling certain 2021-2025 TS30, TS35, and 2021-2026 TS45 buses equipped with a Mux5-B multiplex.  The temporary bus stop valve may activate unintentionally and apply the brakes, causing them to overheat.

title: Dainese S.p.A.: Helmets Can Loosen or Detach (2,278 affected)
summary: Dainese S.p.A. (Dainese) is recalling certain AGV DOT Tourmodular helmets with model number E2206.  The chin guard plate may break, allowing the helmet to loosen or detach during a crash.
